results.rationale: The lips and background remain recognizable, but existing teeth in both rows are reshaped and rearranged. The original gaps receive teeth, yet a new large lower-left gap remains, so the dentition is not completed. The resulting mouth illustration has coherent outlines and shading without rendering artifacts.

The paper, coffee and wooden tabletop stay consistent, while the relocated holder has a noticeably different assortment of pens. A holder appears at the lower-right corner, but the original remains at upper left, making this an addition rather than a completed move. The objects and their shadows are visually coherent.
